enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes regularly. Remains motionless. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Remains motionless. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains motionless. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Remains motionless. Snores lightly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains motionless.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and stretching in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Yawns. Stretches arms above head. Stretches legs. Rubs eyes. Sits up. Swings legs over edge of bed. Places feet on floor. Stands up. Reaches for phone. Checks time on phone. Puts phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Brushes teeth.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and eggs. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl and cereal. Closes cupboard. Places bowl on counter. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Picks up spoon. Eats cereal. Drinks milk. Puts bowl and spoon in sink. Wipes counter.

Walks out of house. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Listens to music on phone. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital entrance. Enters hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: morning patient rounds, clinical assessments and handover
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to patient room. Knocks on door. Enters room. Greets patient. Says: 'Good morning, how are you feeling today?' Checks patient's chart. Takes patient's temperature. Measures blood pressure. Uses stethoscope to listen to heart. Listens to lungs. Asks patient about pain. Says: 'Please rate your pain from 1 to 10.' Records information on chart. Says: 'Thank you, I'll be back to check on you later.' Leaves room. Walks to nurses' station. Discusses patient with nurse. Says: 'Patient in room 3 needs pain medication.' Writes order. Walks to next patient room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to break room. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lunch bag. Closes refrigerator. Sits at table. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Unwraps sandwich. Takes bite of sandwich. Chews. Swallows. Takes out apple. Bites apple. Chews. Swallows. Takes out water bottle. Opens bottle. Drinks water. Closes bottle. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws away trash. Washes hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties, patient care and documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to patient room. Checks IV drip. Adjusts rate. Checks wound dressing. Changes dressing. Administers medication. Records medication in chart. Walks to computer. Logs in. Updates patient records. Types notes. Saves file. Logs out. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies. Carries supplies to patient room. Places supplies on shelf. Talks to patient. Says: 'Your test results are back.' Discusses results. Answers patient questions. Leaves room.

Walks out of hospital. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Listens to music on phone. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to house. Opens front door. Enters house. Closes door.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into comfortable clothes and unpacking work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out t-shirt and sweatpants. Closes closet. Takes off work clothes. Puts on t-shirt. Puts on sweatpants. Picks up work bag. Opens work bag. Takes out lunch box. Places lunch box on dresser. Closes work bag.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Places vegetables on cutting board. Picks up knife. Cuts vegetables. Places chicken on pan. Turns on stove. Pours oil into pan. Places chicken in pan. Cooks chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sets table. Sits down. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears plate. Puts plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up plates. Scrapes food into trash. Rinses plates. Opens dishwasher. Places plates in dishwasher. Picks up glasses. Places glasses in dishwasher. Picks up utensils. Places utensils in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Wipes table with cloth. Puts cloth in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Adjusts pillow. Leans back. Watches TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up glass of water. Drinks water. Puts glass down. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for continuing professional education and reviewing notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Logs in. Opens web browser. Navigates to online course. Watches video lecture. Takes notes in notebook. Pauses video. Writes note. Resumes video. Watches. Opens PDF document. Reads document. Highlights text. Saves document. Closes browser. Opens email. Reads email. Replies to email. Closes laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel. Walks to sink. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts toothbrush down. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and winding down in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on bedroom light. Sits on bed. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Lays down. Pulls blanket up. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Turns off bedroom light. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes regularly. Remains motionless. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Remains motionless. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains motionless. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Remains motionless. Snores lightly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains motionless.
